title: LuaLander
description: Easy questions from the first game: singletons, events, physics and particles.

questions.prompt: Which pattern does this line set up?
questions.code: public static Lander Instance { get; private set; }
options: Singleton - one Lander that any script can reach through Lander.Instance
Object pooling
A ScriptableObject asset
Dependency injection through the Inspector
questions.explanation: A static Instance property with a private setter is the singleton pattern. Lander sets it in Awake (Instance = this), and GameManager then reaches it with Lander.Instance.OnLanded += ...

options: Fires the event only if at least one listener is subscribed, so it never throws a NullReferenceException
Fires the event on the next frame
Fires the event and waits until every listener finishes
Checks whether the Lander is null before firing
questions.explanation: An event with no subscribers is null. ?. calls Invoke only when it is not null - the safe way to fire C# events.

questions.prompt: fuelConsumptionAmount is 1f. While the player holds thrust, how fast does fuel drop?
options: About 1 unit per second, no matter the frame rate
1 unit every frame
1 unit every physics step, so faster on a faster PC
It drops only once, when thrust starts
questions.explanation: Multiplying by Time.deltaTime turns 'per frame' into 'per second'. With fuelAmountMax = 10f, a full tank lasts about 10 seconds of thrust.

questions.prompt: The lander touches a landing pad with a relative velocity magnitude of 5. What happens?
options: Crash - TooFastLanding, because 5 > 4
Successful landing with a lower score
Nothing - the speed is checked only on the terrain
The lander bounces and gets another try
questions.explanation: Anything faster than 4 counts as too hard. The early return means the angle check and score below never run.

questions.code:
float dotVector = Vector2.Dot(Vector2.up, transform.up);
float minDotVector = .90f;
options: When the lander stands perfectly upright
When the lander is upside down
When the lander lies on its side
When the lander moves upwards at speed 1
questions.explanation: The dot product of two unit vectors is 1 when they point the same way, 0 at 90°, -1 when opposite. Below 0.90 the landing counts as TooSteepAngle.

questions.prompt: The lander hits a rock that has no LandingPad component. What does this code do?
options: TryGetComponent returns false, so the lander crashes with WrongLandingArea
It throws a NullReferenceException
It adds a LandingPad to the rock
It ignores the collision
questions.explanation: TryGetComponent returns true and fills the out variable only if the component exists. One call both checks and fetches.

questions.prompt: Which class switches the thruster particles on when the player thrusts?
options: LanderVisuals - it listens to Lander's events
Lander - right after AddForce
GameManager
The ParticleSystem decides by itself
questions.explanation: Lander only fires events and never touches visuals. LanderVisuals subscribes and reacts. Logic stays separate from visuals - the same split FerryHeist uses.

questions.prompt: True or false: SetEnabledParticleSystem(..., false) destroys the particle system.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: False. Disabling the emission module only stops new particles from spawning. Particles already alive finish their lifetime, so the flame fades instead of vanishing.

questions.prompt: True or false: levelNumber keeps its value when the next level's scene loads.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: True. Static fields belong to the class, not to the GameManager object, so they survive a scene reload. That is why ResetStaticData exists - to start fresh from the main menu.

questions.prompt: The lander has 8 fuel and picks up a fuel canister. How much fuel does it have afterwards?
options: 10 - the tank is capped at fuelAmountMax
8 - the pickup only works on an empty tank
questions.explanation: 8 + 10 = 18, but the if clamps it to fuelAmountMax (10f). Mathf.Min(fuelAmount + addFuelAmount, fuelAmountMax) would do the same in one line.
